api_analysis.hypothesis: The compile error is caused by using `torch::return_types::max` which requires the full torch/extension.h header for the return_types definition, but the binding file only includes minimal headers (<torch/types.h> and <torch/csrc/utils/pybind.h>). Additionally, the binding attempts to construct a named tuple directly, but the contract requires returning a plain tuple of (values, indices). Fix by returning a `std::tuple<torch::Tensor, torch::Tensor>` instead of torch::return_types::max, which is easy to construct and satisfies the tuple requirement.
